purpose: Source-derived recovery coverage contract; not evidence of a current backup, asset, provider continuity, or successful restore.

notes: All 27 installed current-app tables are durable application state, including session authority and media references.
socialUploads preserves database references only; object bytes and derivation material have separate continuity requirements.
The current source does not create these eight observed admin tables. A recovery drill must restore them and the catalog-listed helpers together.
postPublishReceipts contains retry/idempotency state and remains durable when a referenced post is deleted.
health_runs is retained operational history. Its presence or a healthy row never proves that an external backup or recovery succeeded.
oauth_pending_states is transient single-use OAuth state. Apply/retain its schema and access contract, but restore it empty rather than replaying pending flows.

If the optional email/provider identity feature is enabled, provider_links is durable identity mapping state and must be restored with the application rows. If disabled, do not fabricate it or claim it was recovered.

No ledger rows, account identifiers, managed storage references, object bytes, or derivation/signing material are embedded in this manifest or exposed through public readiness output.

   FROM circles_admin.operators o
  WHERE ((o.id = audit.actor_operator_id) AND ((o.status)::text = 'active'::text) AND ((o.role)::text = (audit.actor_role)::text))))

external_verification_requirements.provenance: A parent-authorized owner or connector must read current external evidence. This checker never opens a network, database, provider, GitHub, backup, or media connection.
required_attestations: a current successful backup run and its expected encrypted asset set were inspected read-only
artifact integrity and retention were checked without recording locations, credentials, keys, URLs, or asset contents
an isolated non-production PostgreSQL 17 restore target was used
the durable application, admin, publish and health-history groups were compared as schema/data coverage
OAuth pending state was recreated empty after restore
media object bytes and existing derivation/signing-material continuity were verified separately
provider-managed auth/storage/configuration and custom-role continuity were verified through authorized controls
optional identity mapping was explicitly marked restored only if the feature is enabled
external_verification_requirements.attestation_limit: A syntactically complete redacted evidence document only records a reviewer assertion. It is not independently verified by this script and is not proof of a live recovery.
